column5: Called directly by the atlas parser after reading a name, dimensions and four UV values.
Region constructor reads and increments the ID counter after writing the name and UV bounds, and atlas loader uses this ID as the array subscript.
The two ABI header words precede eleven code pointers including score output, pause and resume. The engine constructor and destructor both install the address eight bytes past the header.
The renderer setup saves the trigonometric and easing table allocation here, and the base destructor reloads and disposes it.
Frees and resets the lookup table pointers initialized by the math table constructor. The base engine destructor calls it before operator delete.
